lemma_quote: Ὅπως πληρωθῇ τὸ ῥηθὲν διὰ τῶν προφητῶν, ὅτι Ναζωραῖος κληθήσεται
lemma_quote_en: So that there might be fulfilled the thing spoken through the prophets, that 'He shall be called a Nazarene'
notes: Second half of Matt. 2:23. OCR «κὐρίσκεται» = εὑρίσκεται. The 'Nazarene' prophecy is unlocatable in extant prophets, as Theophylact notes.
